marketing.homeDescription: Your next idea deserves a head start. A Next.js website, a working app, and shared packages for auth, data, billing, and UI. All in one open source template.
marketing.demoNotice: This site uses example content for demonstration.
marketing.templateTitle: A starting point for your project
marketing.templateDescription: {brand} includes an app shell, authentication, data, and example pages so you can focus on your product.
marketing.sharedDescription: Separate website and app. Shared UI, backend, translations, and emails. Turborepo runs the workspace together.
marketing.readyDescription: Build with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. Edit the components you own, with light and dark themes included.
marketing.authTitle: A way in for your users.
marketing.authDescription: Sign-in, sign-up, and account screens with Clerk. Authentication is connected to your app and backend.
marketing.pricingDescription: All plans and features on this page are demonstration placeholders.
marketing.a1: An open source starting point for a web product. It includes a public Next.js website, a separate application, and shared packages for the pieces they both use.
marketing.q2: What do I need to get started?
marketing.a2: Bun and Node.js, plus accounts for the services you use. Clone the repository, install the dependencies, and follow the README to configure your environment.
marketing.q3: Can I change the design and stack?
marketing.a3: Yes. The components and configuration live in your repository. Change the styles, add pages, or replace a provider to fit your project.
marketing.q4: Does it include a working app?
marketing.a4: Yes. The app includes authentication, a dashboard, account settings, and Stripe billing integration. Connect your service credentials to use those integrations locally.
marketing.a5: Yes. Review and adapt it to your requirements before release.
marketing.q6: Why include pricing and FAQ pages?
marketing.a6: They provide common page layouts that you can customize for your project.
marketing.featuresIntro: Start with the parts every project needs. Keep your website and app in sync, then spend your time on what makes yours different.
marketing.dataDescription: A Convex backend with typed queries and live updates. Share the same data layer across your application.
marketing.billingDescription: Stripe subscriptions, a billing portal, and invoices. React Email templates give your transactional emails a starting point.
marketing.languagesDescription: English and Spanish across the website and app, with shared translation catalogs and a saved language preference.
marketing.startDescription: Clone the repo and install the dependencies. Follow the setup guide to connect your services, then make the first change that is yours.
marketing.closingTitle: Less setup. More of your idea.
marketing.closingDescription: Grab the code and make something you want to use.
marketing.footerDescription: An open source starting point for your next web product.
